findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bond_presented_key, project_affine_key, project_shor_twin · Private data: affine_translate_text, atc.assert_4d_deconfliction, bond_presented_key, code_ir_equiv, execute_artifact_crucible, execute_transition, project_affine_key, release_regression, scene_compose, study_usda, verify_jordan_bond, verify_presented_pair · Public sink: bond_presented_key, code_ir_equiv, execute_artifact_crucible, expose, project_affine_key, project_shor_twin, twin.robotics.evaluate_exact_ik, umc_direct, verify_presented_pair · Destructive: execute_2local_hamiltonian, execute_artifact_crucible, execute_exact_permanent, execute_transition, game_frame_meta, math_court.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bond_presented_key, project_affine_key, project_shor_twin · Private data: affine_translate_text, atc.assert_4d_deconfliction, bond_presented_key, code_ir_equiv, execute_artifact_crucible, execute_transition, project_affine_key, release_regression, scene_compose, study_usda, verify_jordan_bond, verify_presented_pair · Public sink: bond_presented_key, code_ir_equiv, execute_artifact_crucible, expose, project_affine_key, project_shor_twin, twin.robotics.evaluate_exact_ik, umc_direct, verify_presented_pair · Destructive: execute_2local_hamiltonian, execute_artifact_crucible, execute_exact_permanent, execute_transition, game_frame_meta, math_court

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
